hypothesis: candidate_pool: raw SEC Companyfacts quarterly DPO extending versus the comparable prior-year quarter (average AccountsPayable / quarterly COGS rising = supplier financing or bargaining power), with non-collapsing COGS/gross-profit context and liquid SPY-relative leadership, may identify cash-conversion leaders before a 10-trading-day continuation leg.

prediction.confidence_reason: This tests a materially different free PIT working-capital field from receivables collection, inventory turnover, debt, lease, and SBC: supplier-financing / bargaining-power improvement. The disconfirmer is that rising payables can also signal stress, so gross-profit/COGS stability and all three canonical windows are required.

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same raw SEC accounts-payable instant mapping, filed-date PIT quarterly COGS and gross-profit context, comparable-quarter DPO extension gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
